raw.query: SELECT resolution, model, count(*) AS wins, round(100.0*count(*)/sum(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY resolution),1) AS pct FROM provenance.v_forecast_best GROUP BY resolution, model ORDER BY resolution, wins DESC
